title: Thermal Nociception Threshold at the Knee in Wistar Rats Protocol
author: Ashleigh Abbott
materials: An ambiguous response to the stimulus is if during or after the temperature range the rat moves/slightly raises or shakes its leg from the thermode without vocalizing. If a rat has an ambiguous response, repeat the measurement or application of the probe again; record as positive (X) or a negative (O) response along with QST.lab data.

steps.title: Prepare QST.Lab Equipment
steps.instruction: Power on and configure the QST.Lab module (TCS II Model) and T10 probe (~0.25" diameter).

substeps.instruction: Turn on the module using the on/off switch on the right side.
Plug the response trigger into the input labeled 'Response' on the right side of the module.
Create an experimental protocol to set the temperature range, ramp rate, test series, and start/stop settings.
Open the protocol by navigating to 'Thresholds and Standard Protocols' and selecting either 'cool' or 'heat'.

steps.title: Configure Thermal Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the program for either heating or cooling until a response or time limit is reached.

substeps.instruction: Heating parameters: baseline of 30°C, temperature ramp increase of 0.5°C/second to 50°C.
Cooling parameters: baseline of 30°C, temperature ramp decrease of -0.5°C/second to 0°C.

steps.title: Prepare the Animal
steps.instruction: Acclimate and position the Wistar rat for testing.

substeps.instruction: Allow rats to acclimate to the room for 30 minutes after bringing cages to the testing area.
The first experimenter (handler) should sit and hold the rodent in a C-hold against their chest, with the dorsal side facing the chest and the knee facing out.

steps.title: Position the Probe
steps.instruction: Locate the knee joint space and apply the thermode.

substeps.instruction: Uncap the T10 probe; hold the probe in the dominant hand and the response trigger in the non-dominant hand.
Once the rat is settled, the second experimenter should lightly palpate the knee to locate the joint space (feeling for the fibular head/BB-like structure on the lateral side).
Apply the thermode flush with the skin overlying the joint space, maintaining a perpendicular angle to the knee.

steps.title: Perform Thermal Stimulation
steps.instruction: Execute the stimulation and record the response.

substeps.instruction: Tap the Start button to begin the countdown and subsequent heating/cooling.
Press the response trigger immediately upon noting a response (audible vocalization, visual withdrawal, or reflexive withdrawal).
If no response occurs after a ten-second count, it is recorded as a negative/non-response.
Pressing the trigger stops stimulation and returns the element to 30°C.

steps.title: Record Data and Reset
steps.instruction: Document the trial results and return the animal to its cage.

substeps.instruction: Remove the probe and record the temperature at withdrawal.
Record the response as positive (X) or negative (O).
If positive, specify the type: vocalization, visual withdrawal, or reflexive withdrawal.
Record data displayed on the QST.lab device (response temperature, delta of temp, etc.).
Return the rodent to its home cage.

steps.title: Complete Testing Sequence
steps.instruction: Repeat the procedure across different knee aspects and temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Test all rats at one aspect (e.g., medial) before moving to the next aspect (anterior, then lateral).
Leave 30 minutes between trials on the same rat.
Repeat all steps for heat after completing all cool trials.
